revision: v2: adds the field-based receiptcert kind. v1 (published at commit 3020c5aa) treated receipt/fold recompute files as provenance-only and undercounted certified roots whose certificates are documented per-entry inside those files (e.g. the cost-58c receipts recompute: 33/33 folded entries certified:true with rows/md5/sub_roots_pass, all certificates asserted against published bytes with BigInt and Number Bareiss verifier PASS). v2 counts such entries as tier R evidence; remaining N roots are unchanged or fewer

basis.reconstruction: 771 basis roots via fold_projection_head1450_tool_20261116.reconstruct() with per-file git-blob pin verification; +4 roots from class-frontier-cost76d77e-receipts-recompute-20261116.json totals.root_hexes (all popcount 7, asserted) = 775 WIN-receipt roots folded into the head-1452 basis

method.provenance: every root is attributed to the basis/receipt JSON files that contributed it (BASE_WIN7_ONLY, class-frontier-* basis blobs, NAMED_FRONTIER, the 66c fold JSON, and the 76d/77e receipt recompute); completeness asserted over all 775
method.cert_scan: scanned files: output/*.json, output/tmp-cost*/bit*.json, output/class2-lane-cost*-certificates/*, and the 69c manifest under n11/output; evidence kinds: bareiss, bigint, tsverify, bigintaudit, verified, verdictverify, orbitverify, receipt, receiptcert, summary, certpart, manifest, warmcert, class4cert, certbacked

tier_definitions.V: raw independent verification artifact present in the scanned set (bareiss/bigint/tsverify/bigintaudit/verified/verdictverify/orbitverify)
tier_definitions.R: published certificate record or artifact documenting or pointing to independent verification (manifest/warmcert/class4cert/certbacked/receipt/summary/certpart); raw verifier output not in scanned subset
tier_definitions.N: no certificate evidence found in the scanned set

conservative_notes: a WIN mention in a frontier or receipt recompute file is not certificate evidence by itself; per-entry certificate documentation (certified:true with rows, md5 and sub_roots_pass) is counted as receiptcert evidence
only popcount-7 roots with WIN7-style or absent verdicts are counted as certified
uncertified (N) may overcount the at-risk set, never undercount it
win23/win13/win6/win3/win2/win1 certificate records concern non-7-stone roots and are excluded by the popcount filter

interpretation_guard: solved 1452 is manifest cover bookkeeping of the head-1452 frontier; this census does not change any frontier number
a WIN7-D10 certificate proves only that its individual 7-stone root is a first-player win within depth 10
REFUTED-D10 entries are not LOSS proofs

uncertified (N) roots are folded WIN receipts without counted certificate evidence: they are 76c-bit113-style bookkeeping risks until certificates are published and independently verified. Level-1 (cert_published_unverified): a certificate file with rows+md5 is referenced but verification is not documented in the scanned set. Level-2 (verdict_only): no certificate artifact referenced at all
